meta.publication_context: 2026年多州警察、卫生机关和公共资料发布
meta.method: State government/police originals preferred; agency-attributed reports accepted with source type. Each selected offence key/group has its own scope; absence is missing, never zero. Substance totals and PKS general/trade subkeys must never be added across differing scopes. Sachsen and Hamburg added directly from 2025 Land police primary PKS tables; overlapping subcategories are explicitly named.
meta.mortality_scope: Recorded drug-related deaths; state data from police/health ministries or organizations and public broadcasters quoting them. Methods and as-of dates may differ; do not add to BKA crime numbers.
